abstract: PURPOSE: Adjuvant radiation therapy (ART) for stage I seminoma can cause adverse late effects and alternative postorchiectomy management strategies have been developed. This study evaluated ART trends in the United States and the impact of clinical and sociodemographic factors on ART recommendations. METHODS: Of men diagnosed with stage I seminoma from 1990 through 2004, 3,125 were identified using the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results cancer registry. A multivariable logistic regression analysis was performed to assess whether there was a significant association between diagnosis year, diagnosis age, race, county education level, region, tumor size, tumor category, and the recommendation for ART. RESULTS: There was a significant association (P < .001) between later year of diagnosis and a decrease in ART recommendation. Compared with men diagnosed in 1990 to 1994, men diagnosed in 1995 to 1999, and 2000 to 2004 were less likely to have ART (adjusted odds ratio [OR], 0.63; 95% CI, 0.48 to 0.84; and OR, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.37 to 0.63, respectively). There also was a significant association (P < .001) between county education level and ART recommendation. Men residing in counties with the highest education level were more likely to receive ART than men residing in counties with the lowest education level (OR, 2.12; 95% CI, 1.59 to 2.82). Also, men older than 30 years were more likely to receive ART than men age 30 or younger (OR, 1.26; 95% CI, 1.03 to 1.55). CONCLUSION: ART recommendations for stage I seminoma are declining. Men in less educated regions and the youngest men were less likely to receive a recommendation for ART.
abstract_ja: 目的：病期I精巣セミノーマに対する補助放射線療法（ART）は晩期有害事象を生じうるため、術後の代替的管理戦略が開発されている。本研究では、米国におけるART実施の動向と、ART推奨に対する臨床的・社会人口統計学的因子の影響を評価した。方法：1990年から2004年に病期Iセミノーマと診断された男性3,125例を、SEER（Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results）がん登録から同定した。診断年、診断時年齢、人種、郡の教育水準、地域、腫瘍径、腫瘍カテゴリーとARの推奨との関連を評価するため、多変量ロジスティック回帰分析を行った。結果：診断年が新しいほどART推奨が減少していた（P<.001）。1990〜1994年と比較すると、1995〜1999年および2000〜2004年に診断された男性はARを受ける可能性が低かった（調整オッズ比［OR］0.63、95%信頼区間0.48〜0.84；OR 0.49、95%信頼区間0.37〜0.63）。郡の教育水準とAR推奨にも有意な関連があった（P<.001）。最も教育水準の高い郡に居住する男性は、最も低い郡の男性よりARを受ける可能性が高かった（OR 2.12、95%信頼区間1.59〜2.82）。また、30歳超の男性は30歳以下の男性よりARを受ける可能性が高かった（OR 1.26、95%信頼区間1.03〜1.55）。結論：病期Iセミノーマに対するART推奨は減少している。教育水準の低い地域に居住する男性と最年少の男性は、ART推奨を受ける可能性が低かった。
